main_body: wooden shack with sloped thatch/shingle roof
top_band: golden-brown sloped roof surface with tiered thatch/shingles, rows 0 to 36
evidence: The sloped roof occupies rows 0-36 as an overhead foreshortened surface with a bright front-edge highlight at row 35 and overhang lip at row 36. Below that, rows 37-39 show a dark eave shadow over the recessed wooden front wall, door, and shuttered window (rows 37-63).

style.evidence: The roof and wooden walls have rich, multi-step shading (5-6 tones on the roof ramp and wood planks) and detailed texture with no flat fills. However, unlike the Beodeul reference buildings which use dark brown/maroon material tones along roof edges and wall borders, the candidate uses a heavy, nearly pure black outline along the left and right edges of the roof and walls.
